original.statement: The CLI --no-proxy flag value was stored in the wrong variable; this is fixed so the flag value is honoured.

corrected.statement: The CLI --no-proxy flag's value was stored in the wrong variable; the fix changes how the flag's value is stored and used.

decision.reason: [ev-74fec6f20224] says only "fix(cli): wrong variable to store --no-proxy value". That supports a behavior-changed fix to the --no-proxy flag: the configuration stays the same, but the flag's value now ends up in the right variable. The evidence names the owning component only as "cli". It never says "argocd", so the proposed component comes from outside knowledge rather than the text. I copied the component as "cli" from the commit scope.
